• INSERT users (name, email, bcrypt_pass, isEmailVerified=false, otp)
NIK mentah dibuang dari RAM (Kepatuhan UU PDP No. 27/2022)

Return: { id, name, email, walletAddress, role, organizersId }
• toWebAuthnKey({ passkeyName: email, mode: Register, rpID })
2. Prompt Biometrik OS & Komputasi Alamat Deterministik (Sepolia Chain 11155111)
• Private Key tetap di HP/Laptop; keluar: pubX, pubY, credId
3. Return { pubX, pubY, credentialId, walletAddress } → activateWalletAction()
• Kirim { userId, pubX, pubY, credentialId, walletAddress }
